_note: Per-client MoEngage account details for the CLI (moengage_qa_agent.py --client <KEY>) only - the Streamlit app (app.py) takes Workspace ID/API Key/Data Center/Client Name as manual input each session instead and does not read this file. Fill in workspace_id / api_key / data_center below directly, OR (preferred, so secrets never sit in a file you might commit) leave them blank here and set them as environment variables named MOENGAGE_WORKSPACE_ID_<CLIENT_KEY>, MOENGAGE_API_KEY_<CLIENT_KEY>, MOENGAGE_DATA_CENTER_<CLIENT_KEY> - e.g. for HOAD_IND: MOENGAGE_WORKSPACE_ID_HOAD_IND, MOENGAGE_API_KEY_HOAD_IND, MOENGAGE_DATA_CENTER_HOAD_IND. Env vars always win over the values in this file. Note: HOAD is not one account - it's 3 separate dashboards (HOAD_IND, HOAD_USA, HOAD_UAE) plus a related 4th dashboard (ANDGD_IND), each its own MoEngage workspace with its own credentials.
